blind.description: A traditional wooden curio or specimen cabinet crafted in medium-dark brown stained wood. The lower section consists of a two-door cupboard with small round brass knobs and corner strap hinges, supported by four short block feet. Above the cupboard is a 3-column by 4-row grid of twelve display cubbies containing various curiosities and natural specimens (including an animal skull, a seashell, a purple crystal cluster, a teal jar, a small bird figurine, an egg on a stand, coral, an hourglass, a shark tooth, a geode, and other shells). The rear of the cabinet is glazed, though interior display items appear backface-culled or missing when viewed from behind.
blind.from_above: A simple horizontal wooden rectangle representing the top crown molding, slightly wider at the lip with raised decorative side edges.
